text:
Elena (Mktg): Quick creative ask for next launch wave — small, high-impact bundle to hand to growth + ops. Need initial drafts in 24h, final exports in 48h. Items: 1) compact benchmark microtile (mobile-first) + desktop grid PNG, 2) two social card orientations (1200x630 and 1080x1080) with two CTA copy variants, 3) webinar hero (1600x900) + single summary slide (1200x675), 4) email header (600x200) light/dark, 5) editable inbound routing diagram (SVG) showing canary split, and 6) 1-page localization & brand checklist. Keep it small and brand-safe.

Ravi (Design): OK. Couple clarifications: benchmark microtile 10 words max per model? do you want sparklines or numeric bars? Also prefer photo or illustration for hero?

Elena (Mktg): Sparklines please (tiny). Limit copy to 10 words/model. Hero: illustration to match recent bench tiles. Use neutral background to keep contrast high.

Sam (Growth): For CTAs, we want two variants: "Compare the numbers" and "Latency vs Cost". Also request an isolated CTA layer in Figma so we can hot-swap text in ads.

Nina (PMM): Legal: no direct competitor names or logos; anonymize models ("Model X"). Accessibility: include alt-text for every asset and provide contrast ratios in the checklist. Also add guidance for translated copy length (EN->DE/JP notes).

Jorge (Legal): Confirming: no competitor marks, and avoid claims like "fastest" without benchmark footnote. Please include a small disclaimer line on the LP and slide: "Benchmarks on representative workloads."

Ravi (Design): Noted. File deliverables: Figma page + PNG exports + SVG diagram + PDF checklist. I'll follow these specs: microtile 640x360 (mobile view), grid 1200x720, hero 1600x900, slide 1200x675, socials 1200x630 & 1080x1080, email header 600x200. CTA area anchored bottom-right with 16px safe zone.

Ravi (Design): Quick naming convention for exports:

```
launch_4975/
  bench_microtile_modelX_640x360.png
  bench_grid_1200x720.png
  social_1200x630_ctaA.png
  social_1080x1080_ctaB.png
  hero_1600x900_v1.png
  slide_1200x675_v1.pdf
  email_header_light_600x200.png
  diagram_inbound_canary.svg
  brand_localization_checklist_4975.pdf
```

Elena (Mktg): Love the naming. One more: make the microtile numbers readable at 2x scale (for retina). Add a tiny legend and a winners badge (single color) for top performer.

Sam (Growth): For routing diagram, include boxes: webhook -> Redwood Hosted API -> Canary -> Dedicated fallback -> notify Ops. Annotate telemetry and where cost controls (batch size/quantization) live. Canary presets: 5%, 25%, 50% labelled.

Ravi (Design): Will add that. Also I'll include a component for headshots (circular 96px) for speaker overlays and export specs for headshot crop.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder: upload drafts to /shared/launch-assets/4975/drafts/ and final exports to /shared/launch-assets/4975/final/. Set permissions marketing+growth+design. Tag: "launch-4975-bench".

Nina (PMM): Add localization string file (CSV) with header: key, en, de, jp and include alt-text keys for each image.

Elena (Mktg): Timeline recap: drafts in 24h (Figma link), slack ping when drafts up, final pack in 48h. Ping @Sam and me when uploads are ready. Thanks all! :pray:

Ravi (Design): Starting now. Will ping when the Figma drafts are ready (ETA ~18h). :thumbsup:
